summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a routine Form 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing via Item 8.01 and Exhibit 99.1 that the Hong Kong Intellectual Property Department granted a patent (No. HK40048460) covering its CyPath Lung platform, which uses flow cytometry and fluorescent markers to characterize sputum cell populations and predict lung cancer likelihood. No financial terms, board actions, advisors, or structural mechanics were stated. The disclosure is an ordinary intellectual-property milestone, not a special situation, and warrants no risk-arb angle or event-driven position.
